title: In-app contextual guides & inline tutorials
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and deliver a set of in-product contextual guides (micro-tutorial panels, inline doc-link cards, and targeted tooltips) aimed at lowering first-run friction across Console flows: API key creation, model selection, deployment config, and cost controls. Assets include Figma comps for three layout variants (compact strip, floating balloon, side dock), states for first-run / repeat-run / dismissed, copy variants for A/B testing, annotated screenshot overlays for engineering handoff, and a short motion spec for micro-interactions. Focus: make guidance scannable, non-disruptive, accessible (keyboard focus, screen reader text), and localizable.
acceptance_criteria: Figma master file with artboards for Console pages: API Keys, Models, Deployments, Billing; annotated with placement, spacing, and responsive behavior
3 layout variants implemented as exportable PNG/SVG assets and example component spec (copy as tokens) for dev
Copy finalized for EN with copy-id mapping for localization; two A/B variants documented and rationale provided
Motion spec (300ms max for enter/exit) and reduced-motion alternative included
Accessibility checklist filled: keyboard traversable, aria attributes documented, contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for body text
Engineering demo page with screenshots and overlay specs exists in Drive and is linked in ticket
Design review sign-off from PM and Engineering and a follow-up issues list for dev edge cases
tasks: Finalize copy A/B variants for key flows (API keys, model select, deploy, cost tips)
Prepare annotated screenshot overlays for dev (desktop 1440, 1024 widths)
Export component tokens and CSS examples for engineering

Run quick usability test with 6 internal engineers/PMs on Canary branch
